name: Rel.AI MCP
description: Single-workflow local repo bridge for ChatGPT: snapshot, read, deterministic write, verify, diff, and reset.

auth.note: ChatGPT discovers the OAuth endpoints via /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource. Sign in with your Rel.AI dashboard token (REL_AI_MCP_TOKEN).

recommended_first_prompt: Use Rel.AI MCP tools directly. Call relai_repo_snapshot for the workspace. Do not use file search. Do not modify files yet.
